title: Anthropic IPO Likely to Price Above Range Ahead of Debut
summary: Anthropic is expected to price its offering on Nov. 18 and debut on Nasdaq as ANT on Nov. 19, with sources telling CNBC it will likely price above $78.
body_markdown:
## When Is the Anthropic IPO Date?


Anthropic is expected to price its shares on the evening of Wednesday, Nov. 18, and begin trading on Nasdaq on Thursday, Nov. 19, per CNBC's guide. Multiple sources told CNBC's David Faber on Nov. 17 that the deal will likely price above the current range, CNBC reported, with the sources unnamed because they were not authorized to speak publicly.


Until pricing, the terms remain estimates. In its Nov. 10 announcement, Anthropic said its registration statement had been filed with the SEC but was not yet effective, and that no shares could be sold before it takes effect.


## What Is Anthropic Worth?


At the top of its $70 to $78 range, Anthropic would carry a fully diluted valuation of about $1.405 trillion, according to CNBC. That compares with a $965 billion valuation in a May fundraise, TechCrunch reported.

CNBC said most of the nine-month loss came from changes in the fair value of convertible notes and derivative liabilities. The prospectus also includes more than 90 pages of risk factors, according to CNBC.


## Where Will Anthropic Stock Trade?


Anthropic has applied to list its Class A shares on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol ANT, the company said. CNBC's guide says up to 20% of the offering is expected to go to retail investors in the US and other countries.


Class A buyers will have limited say over the company. According to TechCrunch, the founders hold a Class F share with 50.1% of voting power, and the Long-Term Benefit Trust elects a majority of the board. Seven co-founders, including chief executive Dario Amodei, each expect to sell nearly 3.4 million shares in the offering, TechCrunch reported.
